A1.justification: Both PDFs describe MonoFusion. Their complete main texts, equations, tables, figures, and Appendices A–E are readable and matchable. The expanded bibliography shifts the appendix without removing material.

before.justification: v1 reports original reconstruction experiments on Panoptic Studio and Ego-Exo4D/ExoRecon, including quantitative comparisons, ablations, and qualitative analyses in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including Tables 1–3 and the additional baseline and depth-estimator comparisons in Appendices A and D.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.4 retain the same Gaussian representation, DUSt3R/MoGe depth alignment, feature-clustered motion bases, and optimization losses. The new PyPose acknowledgment does not establish a procedural change.

E1.justification: Both versions use Panoptic Studio and the same ExoRecon activity coverage. Held-out-frame reconstruction and the novel-view scenarios, including the appendix's 5° and 45° visualizations, are unchanged.

E2.justification: The main comparisons retain SOM, Dyn3D-GS, MV-SOM, and MV-SOM-DS. Appendix A retains MV-MonST3R, MV-MegaSAM, ViewCrafter, DNGaussian, and InstantSplat; Appendix D retains the same depth-estimator alternatives. Newly cited works are not added as evaluated comparators.

E3.justification: The camera configurations, held-out-frame and novel-view procedures, metrics, sample descriptions, resolution, and training settings remain unchanged. The PyPose sentence supplies implementation information without reporting a revised evaluation protocol.

E4.justification: Table 3's component ablations, motion-basis analyses, training-view checks, alternative depth initializations, and SAM/depth failure examples are retained. The additional future-work suggestions introduce no new analysis or test.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, random-seed information, confidence intervals, or significance tests. No uncertainty-reporting practice is added or revised.

E6.justification: All matched numerical results and qualitative figure content remain unchanged. For example, Table 1 retains MonoFusion's full-frame PSNR values of 28.01 on Panoptic Studio and 30.43 on ExoRecon; Appendix A retains 30.64.

T1.justification: The mathematical definitions and Equations 1–6, covering projection, depth alignment, motion composition, and losses, are unchanged. Neither version adds a theorem, proof, or substantive derivation relative to the other.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list, and conclusion retain the same scientific claims about sparse-view dynamic reconstruction, combining monocular priors, and superior reconstruction performance. The deleted resource-availability sentence changes access information rather than these core contributions.

C2.justification: Appendix E adds completion as a possible aid to dynamic-mask inference, and Figure 12's caption adds affordance-specific fine-tuning as a future direction. The existing limitations concerning prompting, inaccurate masks, and human-depth estimation remain unchanged.

D1.justification: v2 removes the abstract's code, data, and processing-script availability statement and its GitHub hyperlink, without a replacement access route. Appendix C newly identifies PyPose for held-out-view synthesis. Hyperparameters remain unchanged; the PDFs do not establish that the repository itself was withdrawn.

R1.justification: The bibliography expands from 72 to 97 entries, substantially broadening cited coverage across reconstruction, autonomous driving, tracking, segmentation/completion, and robotics software. Additions include AdaGar, MonoSplat, PTT, DepthSSC, InstructPart, and PyPose. These mainly enter the introduction and appendix; the central novelty positioning and Section 2 discussion remain largely unchanged.

P1.justification: Edits are localized: the abstract loses its availability sentence, the appendix gains several short statements, and Appendix D's heading capitalization changes. The section organization and most explanatory prose are retained.

P2.justification: Figure 12's caption expands, references and nearby text reflow, and printed page numbers disappear. The figure panels, table structures, and overall two-column presentation remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v2 preserves the scientific method and evidence but removes v1's only direct link to code, data, and processing scripts, weakening reproducibility guidance. The PyPose disclosure and additional literature and future-work pointers offer modest benefits, but do not compensate for losing that concrete access route. The resulting decline is limited.
